int_name: JOHN F KENNEDY BLVD & N SCHUYLKILL AVE W

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane roadway located beneath a heavy bridge structure, characterized by a complete absence of pedestrian infrastructure. Concrete barriers line the roadway, and the environment is designed exclusively for high-volume vehicular traffic, making it extremely hostile for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or designated walking areas, forcing any pedestrian into the path of high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide lanes and concrete barriers suggest a high-speed environment with no traffic calming.

hazards.name: Poor Visibility and Lighting
hazards.description: The under-bridge environment is relatively dark, and bridge supports create potential blind spots.

interventions.title: Install Separated Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: If pedestrian access is required, a physically separated and protected walkway should be constructed.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Improve the quality and coverage of lighting to increase visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Prohibition Signage
interventions.description: If this is a restricted-access highway, clear signage should be installed to prevent pedestrians from entering the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow, neglected walkway located beneath a heavy bridge structure alongside a body of water. The environment lacks standard pedestrian infrastructure, is poorly maintained with visible debris, and offers no clear connection to a broader sidewalk network.

hazards.name: Debris and Trip Hazards
hazards.description: Loose debris and uneven surfaces on the narrow walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground on the walkway surface.

hazards.name: Confined Space and Poor Visibility
hazards.description: The area under the bridge is dark and enclosed, creating potential personal safety concerns and poor visibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper half of the image under the bridge deck.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install adequate lighting under the bridge structure to improve visibility and personal security.

interventions.title: Walkway Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular cleaning and repair of the walkway surface to remove debris and fix cracks.

interventions.title: Wayfinding and Signage
interventions.description: Provide clear signage indicating where the path leads and connecting it to the safer pedestrian network.

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane roadway underpass completely devoid of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, crossings, or safety barriers for people on foot, creating a highly hostile environment.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: No sidewalk or physical barrier exists to protect pedestrians from high-speed vehicle traffic in a confined space.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left and right walls of the underpass

hazards.name: Restricted Sight Lines
hazards.description: The tunnel structure and curvature limit the visibility of any pedestrians to oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: The roadway ahead as it continues under the structure

interventions.title: Raised Protected Walkway
interventions.description: Install a raised sidewalk with a crash-rated barrier to provide a safe, separated path for pedestrians through the underpass.

interventions.title: Enhanced Tunnel Lighting
interventions.description: Upgrade lighting to high-output LEDs to improve visibility for all road users within the dark underpass environment.

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane roadway passing through a dark, industrial underpass with no pedestrian facilities. The environment is characterized by heavy steel overhead structures, concrete barriers, and a complete lack of sidewalks or crossings, making it extremely hostile for people on foot.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Walkway
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or protected path, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or in narrow, unprotected areas.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire length of the roadway.

hazards.name: Poor Lighting
hazards.description: The underpass is dimly lit with industrial fixtures, creating deep shadows and reducing the visibility of anyone on foot.

interventions.title: Dedicated Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Install a raised or barrier-separated sidewalk to provide a safe, continuous route through the underpass.

interventions.title: Improved Underpass Lighting
interventions.description: Upgrade to high-output LED lighting to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility for all road users.
